blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) has earned international recognition for its commitment to using lottery revenues to support public welfare and charitable causes. World Lottery Association (WLA) President Andreas Kötter described Philippine lotteries as an outstanding example of responsible gaming and raising funds for good causes. Kötter made the remarks on the sidelines of the ongoing World Lottery Summit (WLS) 2026 in Sydney, Australia, during which he described Philippine lotteries as an example of how the industry can generate funds for good causes while maintaining its social responsibility.
